note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guides are written in our own words for this entry and cite their sources; where no source has confirmed a step yet, the guide says so plainly.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned. No multiplayer and no DLC is needed, and every trophy is single-player. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4/10, with most of that time going to the 100% completion checklist rather than the story.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when you finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing, at the start of Chapter 1. Just play the story and it pops.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 1 ends, which PowerPyx notes happens after you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 2 ends, after you complete the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City, according to PowerPyx. No side content is needed for it.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 3 ends, after you complete the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, per PowerPyx. Just keep following the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks when Chapter 4 ends, after you complete the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero, according to PowerPyx.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: The story gold. It unlocks when you finish the final mission of the game — PowerPyx ties it to the same final mission, Starting From Zero, that closes Chapter 4. There is no mission replay, so enjoy the ending; free-roam continues after the credits.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. This mission also matters later: PowerPyx notes it is the point after which you can free-roam as both Jason and Lucia together, which several other trophies need.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown, the airport takedown. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one the whole platinum revolves around. The 100% checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient, closer to 60% true completion: you need 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied with binoculars, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 optional missions, while robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting-range golds, drone races and Bret's Target Decks must be done in full. Nothing on the checklist is missable; everything can be finished in free-roam after the credits.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. You can mix kinds freely, and under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and found stunts stay marked on the map.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types, and you need one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. PowerPyx notes you will be introduced to most of them by the story and the rest show up as you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on other trophies. Check Progress, then Activities, to see which types you have done.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: There are 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 ranges, and every one needs a gold medal. PowerPyx links a dedicated guide to all 12 range locations and the 42 golds, and notes the golds are not too difficult. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Work through the ranges after the story when you have better weapons.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun drone race locations and 42 drone races in total, according to PowerPyx, and you need a win at every location. Drone races also count as one of the activity types for Master of None, and all of them are required in full for the 100% checklist, so there is no shortcut — win each location once.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the game's race locations — PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations in total. Any 20 wins count, and a win also ticks one of the activity types for Master of None. Pick the short races you are comfortable with and repeat the ones you win; each new location you win at brings you closer.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline from there and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing itself also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: There are 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. PowerPyx says the first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, from Chapter 1 onward, while Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all its levels at least once — you do not need to beat every challenge. Pick whichever game suits you best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts her home address, marking the questline in Belville. All quests stay available after the story. PowerPyx lists the five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse). Finish the last one and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you treasure diving: he marks purple treasure chest icons on the map, you find the underwater treasures with a metal detector and bring them back. PowerPyx says he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total, in several sets — turn in one set and he calls you back with more. Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so the trophy is not missable. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. All quests stay available after the story. PowerPyx lists the five quests: Thrillbillies (check out the mud club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. Finish the last one for the trophy.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks are side quests found in the open world, but only certain questlines count — PowerPyx warns that Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. The strands PowerPyx confirms do count are Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile deliveries), with more strangers yet to be discovered. All of them can still be found after the story in free-roam, and your count shows in the trophy tracker. Finish any 8 counting strands.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — PowerPyx lists them, starting with the Granforma Zorrusso (already delivered in the story mission), then the Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros and more. Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, then drive it back to his garage in the west of Vice City (green RK icon); delivering in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It can all be done after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go to the labs and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After destroying enough labs, Tyrone gives his second quest, Spin On This, which shuts the labs down and unlocks the trophy. All of it stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and you can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 meditations at the same location. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. MISSABLE WARNING — the one trophy PowerPyx and GTABase both flag as possibly missable: the first meditation only happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. After Chapter 1 that balcony meditation is gone for good. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed whether that first meditation is required for the trophy, since it is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest — but do it in Chapter 1 anyway to be safe. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
trophies.missable_reason: The first meditation, on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is only available in Chapter 1. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the one possibly missable trophy; whether it counts toward the trophy is still unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, and is exclusive to Jason: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. PowerPyx notes there are 15 Target Decks in total, all required for the 100% checklist, and that it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal unlocks this trophy — so work through Bret's quests and it should pop along the way.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: There are 18 sets of collectible cards in the game — 480 cards in total, per Push Square — and you only need to complete any 3 full sets for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops. Track each set's progress under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida; PowerPyx links a full guide to all 18 set locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the phone app you open by holding Up, then scanning with R1. PowerPyx counts the scannable spots as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — far more than 100, so any 100 count. Scan whatever you pass while playing and this pops naturally; the 100% checklist also wants 100. Track your count under Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in 8 categories of 10, and you only need any 50. The 100% checklist wants any 70, so this pops automatically on the way there. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right shows when one is done. Most complete naturally while you work on other trophies, so leave the leftovers for last and pick the easiest remaining ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage, then escape the red heat zone on the map. PowerPyx recommends a fast sports motorcycle to cut through traffic, shooting down any police helicopter, and notes the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County as an easy escape route, since cops struggle to follow on the tracks. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone, not just out of the flashing search area. It also pops naturally while you rob the large bank vaults, which always trigger 4-star wanted levels.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Then rob 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) in a row while the police are chasing you the whole time — you must keep the red and blue flashing wanted level and never lose it. PowerPyx suggests an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing, and a good spot: the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Loot a couple of items in each store and break the safe in the back room with sticky bombs; if it does not pop after the third store, hit a fourth. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: The game has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. You do not need to drive a vehicle, just scan it. Stand by a busy road and scan the traffic passing by. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way there. Check your totals under Progress, then Vehicles. GTABase gives the same method.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar under your health and stamina. You must take down 5 enemies in a single use, which only lasts a few seconds. PowerPyx recommends buffing your focus first — eat and drink, wash your face or shower at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the focus time — then line up 5 enemies, for example the criminals at gang operations, and drop them quickly with an assault rifle like the Duke 556. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. PowerPyx notes it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane sitting on the airfield. PowerPyx says the easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and next to the boarding bridge there are stairs with a door leading straight into it. Inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the pop is slightly delayed until you are that far out.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. PowerPyx says the tanks stand in the south of the air base: drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, which are then marked with a green icon on unfogged map areas. Break in through the back door using the Snap Gun — the gadget stays in your inventory permanently, and approaching a locked door gives you the choice between kicking it (which triggers the alarm) and the Snap Gun (the stealth approach). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a good location. The trophy pops shortly after you leave the store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (wait at the cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies. You tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash in, and the vault opens — go in quickly and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After that quest, Yasmani (the fence from Chapter 3) sells tips about security vans for $10,000, marking them with a purple icon — do his earlier quests, robbing 2 Payday Loans, first if you have not. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total; you need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% checklist. Each vault pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is…: robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck, since you tail the truck to the bank first. PowerPyx also gives an earlier method: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray). Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map. The map starts covered in black fog, and the trophy pops once none is left. PowerPyx says the fastest way is by plane: fly over every fogged area until the entire map is visible. A plane can be found early in Chapter 1, so you can start clearing fog during the story, but there is no rush — it all counts whenever you do it.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total, per PowerPyx. For this trophy you only need one operation belonging to each gang, but the 100% checklist wants all 39, so it pops on the way there. Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track each gang under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini. Drink it while standing next to the bar, with the view, and the trophy pops. PowerPyx shows the bar and the drink in its guide — no mission or unlock is needed, so you can do this any time you are in Vice City.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it out through the window. PowerPyx says the car is the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City, and only that blue Banshee counts — no other car works. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the showroom window; the pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are further down the street. It is an easter egg referencing the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This is unlocked by stealing all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the Kolt gang operations. Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow up the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the 3 valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway, blown open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. PowerPyx notes it is not missable: if you do not get all 3 during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: This pops when you have maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. It only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check a character's Strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then the character, then Strength (heart icon). You raise Strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon) or work out at home after the story. PowerPyx recommends always going with both characters together (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one works out actively, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: You need 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the count shows when you click the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile on), so a little demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do affects your reputation. The profiles are Professional (stealthy objectives and robberies, destroying evidence, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence, which PowerPyx and GTABase both say to avoid, since cops then shoot at you on sight more often. It should pop naturally while you work on other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If it is still missing at the end, PowerPyx suggests farming it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but watch out for the Irredeemable profile.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified source yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. No guide has pinned down the exact trigger, so do not chase a specific method until one is confirmed; it may pop while you play normally, for example while doing the Payday Loans robberies that the Dime on the Dollar trophy needs.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: This comes from the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx says: go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go solo. The event is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn — sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside, and if it is not there, drive away and come back. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her and offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no verified source yet. PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, and believes it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger, so treat the motorcycle-kick idea as an unconfirmed guess, not a method: try melee attacks from a moving motorcycle against enemies and it may pop, but do not grind it until a guide confirms how it works.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most, per PowerPyx. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, so you do not need to carry it at once. It comes naturally while you do all robberies for the 100% checklist; the large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: Simply spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. PowerPyx says the fastest way is buying guns, car mods and tattoos, since those are the most expensive — the game has 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores. It counts cumulatively, so normal spending while you play adds up; buy your weapons and car upgrades first and this pops on its own.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages; for this trophy you only need the 8 purchasable ones. They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, is installed on your phone. Buy the garages through that phone app. PowerPyx suggests robberies as the quickest money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register 10 vehicles you first need enough garages — see Little Boxes — since each garage adds one or more parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so PowerPyx suggests cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
trophies.name: On the Spot
